confirmatory_scoring_policy: frozen; reliability evaluation is diagnostic and cannot change current-cohort scores, mappings, thresholds, stopping, or headline inclusion

arms.procedure: Classify the identical sealed evidence at least twice in isolated contexts with the same model, prompt hash, frozen settings, and no prior output visible.
Give identical sealed evidence and the identical complete archetype registry to preregistered model versions; preserve every output without adjudicating toward a chart.

At least two trained raters independently classify randomized pseudonymous evidence using the same frozen codebook; raters see no birth data, chart prediction, candidate rank, model output, or reveal status.

required_metrics: Fleiss kappa for equal-size multi-rater panels
agreement stratified by domain, rater arm, confidence band, and classification status
Other, mixed, insufficient-evidence, and unclassifiable rates
exclusions: Post-reveal classifications and adjudications are excluded from confirmatory agreement and headline science.
No reliability result may be used to reinterpret a disagreement as support in the evaluated cohort.
Any scoring or classifier revision creates a new version evaluated only on later untouched participants.
